$comment: Invariant ids owned by the P1 task `p1-foundation-economy-schema`, economy half. One file per task: `pnpm test:coverage-map` unions docs/invariants-owned.json with every docs/owned/*.json and fails if two files claim the same id, so nine parallel P1 tasks can each declare what they own without editing a shared array. Every id here has a test whose name contains it, under packages/core/src/economy/.
